GEOGRAPHY — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

2. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   B. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.

4. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   D. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   C. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   B. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.
   D. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   B. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.

8. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

9. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   C. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.

10. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   B. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Industry as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.

12. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.

13. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   C. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops

15. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.

16. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Avoiding all community work

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Geography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Rocks and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
